findings.finding: The YAML front-matter for plan_review_T15.md specifies `dimension: empirical/approach-soundness` — a compound slash-delimited value. No existing rubric uses a compound dimension; the codebase convention is a single token (e.g. `overlay-empirical` for T2, `approach-soundness` for G6). If the prompt-library or any downstream dimension-keyed dispatch treats this as a novel compound token, it silently creates an undocumented convention and a potential config-surface inconsistency.
scenarios: A future dimension-keyed router or facet-dispatch that splits on the dimension field will either reject or silently misclassify T15.
Automated guide-generation or parity checks that enumerate dimension values will surface an orphan compound token not present in any other rubric.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a single dimension token. If T15 is closer to T2's empirical-validation concern, use `overlay-empirical`; if it is closer to G6's approach-soundness concern, use `approach-soundness`. If it genuinely spans both, define a new single-token dimension (e.g. `overlay-derisk`) to match the criterion name and avoid the compound convention.
